dedupe_keys.name: truecity real and simulated urban data for cross domain 3d scene understanding

description: TrueCity is a benchmark that pairs annotated real-world point clouds, semantic three-dimensional city models and simulated point clouds from the same Ingolstadt street environment. The TUM directory explains that the drive and LiDAR sensor were resimulated using CARLA within the semantic model. The repository describes twelve classes harmonised with CityGML 2.0 and OpenDRIVE 1.4, and real and synthetic segments for assessing domain differences in three-dimensional scene understanding. Coverage is the described local environment, not all of Ingolstadt. Public repository documentation links a dataset storage location and identifies the associated 3DV 2026 work. A dataset-specific licence, complete file formats and access conditions at the linked storage service were not established, so reuse remains uncertain. Caveats include local scope and the need to distinguish simulated observations from measured ground truth. The benchmark supports evaluation of simulated street scenes against measured observations; reported algorithm performance was not adopted or reproduced. Related record data-ingolstadt-lod3-road-space describes the semantic environment components. No point clouds, code files, storage listing or full paper were retrieved.
